ui.title: MBTI × AI: What is your AI companion like?
ui.hero: What is your AI companion like?
ui.intro: A casual survey of how different people use AI, what they enjoy, and what drives them mad. Tell us your everyday habits or one real story.
ui.choice_desc: Pick what sounds like you: uses, chat habits, praise and complaints.
ui.text_desc: Tell us about a real experience in your own words. A few sentences are enough.
ui.entrytext: Think about your habits and opinions over the past 30 days. You do not have to reconstruct a whole work task. People who have not used AI recently are welcome too.
ui.local_notice: Answers are not uploaded automatically. Save a draft before closing or refreshing this page.
ui.footnote: Either form is enough. There is no ideal way to use AI and no personality score. Language versions will keep improving with feedback.
ui.invalid: Complete this item. If unsure, select or write that you do not know.
ui.case: Report ID: {id}. Keep it when adding the other form for this participation.

ui.missing: Complete {n} required items and all three confirmations before exporting.
ui.ready: Required items are complete. Check your answers and what you will share before exporting.
ui.downloaded: Download started. Exporting does not submit anything to GitHub.
ui.copied: Report copied. Paste it into the questionnaire-return Issue.
ui.copy_failed: Copy was not allowed. Download the readable report and copy its text.

ui.import_failed: Cannot load this file. Use an unchanged v0.3 draft saved by this page.

ui.reportnote: These are your own reported habits and opinions. Quotation permission is in A05. Link both forms of the same participation by report ID.
return_steps: Inspect the report and remove anything that should not be public.
Download the JSON data and readable Markdown report.
Return the files or paste the complete report into the GitHub Issue. A pull request is also possible.
ui.privacy: Issues, pull requests and attachments are public and linked to your GitHub account. A report ID does not make you anonymous.
ui.mdintro: An informal survey about MBTI, everyday AI habits, opinions and stories. Think about the past 30 days. This is not a personality test or ability ranking.
ui.mdexposure: This readable form displays all item purposes. Record that exposure when submitting.
ui.condition_equal: Answer only if {id} has been answered with: {label}.
ui.condition_not_equal: Answer only if {id} has been answered with something other than: {label}.
ui.exclusive: Exclusive options (cannot be combined with any others): {labels}.
ui.item_count: {n} items including shared, optional and conditional items. Answer only applicable items.
ui.submit_description: Attach exported files or paste the complete report.
ui.study_description: Share a separate study, its methods and evidence.
ui.study_body: Describe the research question, recruitment, participant count, personality source, AI tasks/tools, methods, findings, limitations and permissions. Separate real data from hypotheses.
ui.discussion_description: Report translation issues or suggest improvements.
ui.discussion_body: Describe the issue, language, item ID and suggested correction. Do not include private information.

about: An uncertain MBTI type is welcome. No need to take another test.
uses: Think about everyday use over the past 30 days, not just your best experience.
style: Choose what best matches your habits. There is no correct style.
opinions: You can like it, dislike it, or feel both ways.
stories: Tell it like you would to a friend. A few sentences are fine.
closing: Choose what may be shared, then review and export.

consents: I am at least 18 and participate voluntarily. I am describing my own real habits, experiences or opinions.
I understand that GitHub submissions are public and linked to my account; a report ID does not provide anonymity.

I have removed private and confidential information and may share this material. I permit this project’s statistics and article summaries, and understand that public copies may not be fully retrievable.

A01.title: What MBTI type do you currently report?
A01.purpose: Link a reported label with behavior; do not infer type from behavior.

A02.title: What is the main source of that type?
A02.purpose: Distinguish formal MBTI, 16Personalities, other tests and self-judgment rather than treating them as one instrument.

A03.title: On roughly how many days did you use generative AI in the past 30 days?
A03.purpose: Record recent frequency separately from cumulative experience.

A04.title: How long have you used generative AI?
A04.purpose: Record AI experience so that familiarity is not misattributed to personality.

A05.title: May the paper quote redacted excerpts from this report verbatim?
A05.purpose: Separate aggregate-analysis consent from quotation permission.
options: Yes; redacted excerpts may be quoted verbatim

A06.title: Did AI help prepare this report?

Q01.title: What have you mainly used AI for recently?
Q01.purpose: Compare actual uses; one person can have several.
options: Talking about emotions or seeking companionship

Q02.title: What does AI feel most like to you?
Q02.purpose: Compare the role people give AI without assigning roles to personality types in advance.
options: A tool for getting things done
Someone to chat with or keep me company

Q03.title: How do you usually start a conversation?
Q03.purpose: Compare expression habits without treating longer prompts as greater ability.
options: Break it into steps and ask one by one
Start talking and work out what I need
It varies a lot by task

Q04.title: When the first reply misses the mark, what do you usually do first?
Q04.purpose: Observe the first response to an unsatisfactory answer.

Q05.title: When asking for advice, what kind of answer do you prefer?
Q05.purpose: Compare preferences for a usable plan, options, explanation or shared exploration.
options: A discussion before an answer takes shape
It mainly depends on the task

Q06.title: How do you respond when AI disagrees with you?
Q06.purpose: Describe responses to disagreement, not rationality or stubbornness.
options: Check the basis for its claim first
Restate what I want and ask it to follow my idea
Decide according to the specific issue

Q07.title: Do you check AI’s answers when important information or judgments are involved?
Q07.purpose: Describe checking habits; frequency does not establish quality or accuracy.
options: I have not used AI for this recently

Q08.title: What is the biggest benefit AI gives you?
Q08.purpose: Describe perceived benefits without calling them measured performance gains.

Q09.title: What bothers you most about AI?
Q09.purpose: Include negative experiences and improvement needs, not only praise.
options: Being verbose or missing the point
Usage limits, costs or tool capabilities
Privacy or how information is used

Q10.title: Overall, are you satisfied with your recent AI experience?
Q10.purpose: Describe satisfaction, separately from trust, accuracy or work ability.

Q11.title: Why have you not used AI recently?
Q11.purpose: Include recent nonusers and describe their barriers and choices separately.
options: Do not know where to start
Do not trust its answers much

Q12.title: Which best describes your current attitude toward AI?
Q12.purpose: Compare overall attitudes while allowing hope and concern together.
options: Enthusiastic and keen to use it

S01.title: Which recent experience with AI stands out to you?
S01.purpose: Use real stories to understand uses, needs and results.
S01.hint: What were you trying to do, and how did AI help or fail to help? Name the tool if you wish. Remove private details.

S02.title: How do you usually talk to AI, and what happens when the answer is not what you wanted?
S02.purpose: Add context to prompting, follow-up, adjustment and judgment habits.
S02.hint: You may give a redacted example or simply describe your habits. Full chat logs are unnecessary.

S03.title: What do you like most about AI, and what would you most like to complain about?
S03.purpose: Retain positive, negative and mixed opinions and their reasons.
S03.hint: You may answer just one side. No strong likes or complaints is also a valid answer.

S04.title: Why have you not used AI recently? What might make you want to try?
S04.purpose: Understand nonusers without treating nonuse as failed use.
S04.hint: No need, not knowing how, disliking it or other reasons are all welcome. Trying it later is not required.

A07.title: In one sentence, how would you describe your relationship with AI?
A07.purpose: Collect participants’ own words for optional quotation with permission.
A07.hint: Optional. Describe your feelings; this is an expression, not a new personality assessment.
